## ANSWERS to your open CONFLICTs (read once, then start the queue)
- §5a resource: CONFIRMED — "costs 1 less" = attunement. Attunement is the game's mana; runes are the pre-game loadout system and Artifacts never touch them. Your read was right.
- Stat scale (0–12 atk / 1–14 vigor vs my assumed 1–8): acknowledged. Artifact numbers stay as-written for now; the sim metric task at the end of this queue is what tells us if they need retuning. Do not adjust numbers yourself.
- ATTUNE op misfit: correct catch — engine ATTUNE raises AttunementMax, which is NOT a discount. The discount mechanic arrives in TASK-DSL-3 below as a new COST_MOD op; launch_artifacts.json entries currently using "ATTUNE" as discounts will be migrated in that same task.

  tactician everywhere, bosses always tactician.
